note: Open oak-grassland campground on the north shore of Camp Far West Reservoir east of Wheatland, with a boat ramp and dock. The full-hookup sites sit by the camp store. A separate South Shore campground opens only on a few holiday weekends. --Claude
summary: Camp Far West North Shore: rates confirmed ($40 lakeside / $65 full hookup + $10 reservation; fees manual, unchanged), 70 sites incl 8 full hookup, year-round, phone booking Mon-Tue 9-2; lakefront holds (outer loop sites 5-9, 14-19 ~15-20 m from the high-water line over open grass); Google 4.3 (727, lake listing); passes price gate.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront holds: official site map puts outer east-loop sites 5-9 and 14-19 on the shoreline (also 46-50, 55-58 on the south side); Esri imagery (lake near full) shows that loop ~15-20 m from the high-water line over open oak grassland, around 39.0385-39.0405,-121.2967; 3DEP loop road ~93 m vs water ~92 m (full pool ~300 ft). All are 'Standard lakeside site' $40, sold by the night.

PRICE GATE (private): cheapest RV night $40 (standard lakeside site; full hookup $65) - passes. Fees group has manual provenance (2026-11-07) and the page still matches - not rewritten. Google 4.3 (727) on the lake-wide listing; RV Life 4.5*/$$. No long-stay or seasonal-resident wording; not age-restricted.

WEBSITE TRUST: cfwlake.com calls itself 'the official Camp Far West Lake website' and carries the lake's phone, but its footer banner reads 'PROTOTYPE — map pin positions are still approximate. Fees, photos & text are real.' Google's listing links Facebook (facebook.com/campfarwestlake), which was not read (login wall). Keep, but worth AWH's eye.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 30 (note prose) - the page says 'full hookups' with no amperage; left unchanged.

SPLIT / LEAD: South Shore (67 sites) is a separate campground but opens only Memorial Day weekend, Father's Day weekend, New Year's and special events - not a nightly campground; not proposed. Not in campgrounds.json.
PIN 39.03632,-121.29909 sits near the boat-ramp/day-use end; the site loops centre ~39.0385,-121.2985 (~245 m N). Under 250 m, no move.
